text: AI moderates 1,000s of video interviews at once · themes, quotes and a cited report in hours
originalText: AI moderates 1,000s of video interviews at once · themes, quotes and a cited report in hours

text:
Key decisions
- Live path (moderator) and batch path
  (analysis) are separate systems
- The guide is a state machine; the LLM
  only phrases and decides to probe
- Every insight keeps interview id +
  timestamp: click a stat, hear the quote
- Queue per stage, idempotent jobs, retries
- Tenant id on every row + row-level security
- Evals gate prompt and model changes
